cases.name: nothing-selected
cases.why: No filter chosen: the browse feed sends none of the parity params and the server applies saved values (scope profile) or nothing.

cases.name: profile-lists
cases.why: Saved-profile list filters. Lists are one comma-joined value (encoding csv), in the order the user picked them.

cases.name: profile-job-type-internship
cases.why: jobModality and internshipLevels travel together for internship seekers; levels are a csv list.

cases.name: profile-role-types-both
cases.why: roleTypes is sent whenever the user chose it, corporate and frontline together included.

cases.name: profile-recency-and-salary
cases.why: Integer filters: postedWithinDays is one of the allowed windows, salaryFloorUsd a plain integer, no thousands separator.

cases.name: request-work-arrangements
cases.why: workArrangements is request-only and csv; web sends the slugs, in_person with an underscore.

cases.name: feed-filters-scope
cases.why: The two feed-filters values: favoriteCompaniesOnly is the string true, industries travel as the sector param in csv.

cases.name: hidden-companies-on
cases.why: hideHiddenCompanies is sent only as the string true, after the user has hidden a company.

cases.name: flags-off-are-omitted
cases.why: A boolean that is off is absent from the wire, not sent as false.

cases.name: device-seniority-skills-all
cases.why: Device-scope filters. A symbol skill (c++) must survive the round trip; skillsMode all is sent, any is not.

cases.name: device-skills-any-mode-omitted
cases.why: skillsMode any is the default and is omitted from the wire even though the user chose skills.

cases.name: device-experience-window
cases.why: min and max years are integers; 0 is a real value and must be sent, not dropped as falsy.

cases.name: device-experience-unknown-only
cases.why: experienceUnknown only; web never sends include (it is the default) so it is not a value a client emits.

cases.name: request-sponsorship
cases.why: sponsorship is request-only; only the two filtering modes are sent.

cases.name: search-symbols-plus
cases.why: search text with a plus sign: decoded, it must stay c++, not become spaces (an unencoded plus decodes to a space).

cases.name: search-ampersand
cases.why: search text with an ampersand: R&D must survive as one value, not split into two parameters.

cases.name: search-quotes-and-space
cases.why: Search-box text that uses the keyword grammar (a double quote, a leading minus, OR, brackets or a field prefix, or any text with description search on) is sent trimmed as q, never as search. TracklyWeb usesKeywordGrammar (src/lib/search-operators.ts) decides this, and every client must route the same way.

cases.name: search-non-ascii
cases.why: search text with non-ASCII letters must be percent-encoded as UTF-8 and decode back unchanged.

cases.name: keyword-query-traps
cases.why: q carries operators and symbols (quotes, OR, ampersand, plus); qIn all adds the description. Web sends q instead of search when it uses the keyword grammar, never both.

cases.name: keyword-query-non-ascii-negation
cases.why: q with a leading minus negation and non-ASCII text. qIn title is the server default and is never sent; clients send qIn only as all.
